description: This file is a PHP source file that manages the display and retrieval of related lists for products within the vtiger CRM module. It handles HTTP request parameters, session management, and renders the related lists view for a specific product record.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity used to retrieve and manipulate product data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific entity record.

methods.name: name
methods.description: The name property stores the product name within the focus object.

methods.name: ismember_check
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a member of the product.
